text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe got injured during 
training, so I brought her to the 
infirmary, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... I'm so, sorry...... Because of 
my carelessness...... you ended up with an 
injury like this――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Huh? You think "we should 
continue training"...?
choice_data_list: I never said anything like that, did I?
I didn't say anything like that, did I?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"......No, not Trainer-san, but someone 
rather passionate... gave me... some 
advice......"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Manhattan Cafe was being spoken 
to by an invisible "someone."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“Guts”... you say? Indeed, the sheer 
amount of heat behind this 
determination... is on a whole different 
level...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Depending on that fervor... the 
impossible... —miracles... might just 
happen... maybe...
choice_data_list:
I can't let you race while you're still 
injured.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Depending on that fervor... the 
impossible... —miracles... might just 
happen... maybe...
choice_data_list:
I can't let you race while you're still 
injured.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...However, there's also the 
possibility... that we can push through 
with 'guts'........."
choice_data_list:
If it gets worse, running will be out of 
the question.

If it gets worse, running will be out of 
the question.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Understood. Got it... I'll let 
them know...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... It seems they were deeply 
moved... Saying 'I am sorry'... and 'I was 
mistaken'..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Your words made me really happy, 
Trainer. I'll make sure to get plenty of 
rest...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Guts... right... Understood...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I'll show you... my gut—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It seems my psychic passion... was 
simply not enough............

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't let this injury get any worse... 
After that, I made sure Manhattan Cafe got 
plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, where shall we begin......?
choice_data_list:
What can you do with everything you've got 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......Let's see... If we're talking full 
effort, there's classroom study, 
stretching, and the like...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Could the 'guts' you're talking about, 
Trainer, mean pouring everything you have 
into those things...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......Training while rehabilitating an 
injury... That is quite efficient...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Even that hot-blooded person is 
nodding along, saying, 'This is very 
educational'............"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ……Understood. I will show you…… my guts……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Manhattan Cafe underwent 
treatment while continuing to train with 
everything she had, making a spectacular 
comeback.
